system.description:
You lash out with a flurry of attacks meant to completely overwhelm your enemy in the blink of an eye.

You make a series of strikes leaving afterimages with each strike. Make a three melee taijutsu attacks. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage Die].

Chain 1: If you score a hit with at least two or more attacks, you increase your speed by +20 feet and the target creature cannot make an attack of opportunity against you until the end of the current turn..

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the bonus damage die by +2. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the bonus damage die by +4.
